name: 90 to 90 press stretch

phases.label: Hinge forward over the front shin
Hold the hip stretch for 1 second

side_note: Front leg is anatomical left; repeat on the mirrored side.
muscle_notice: Illustrative smooth surface emphasis; not EMG, physiological recruitment or true segmentation. Deep hip flexors/adductors/lumbar labels use surface proxies.
interpretation: One representative seated90/90 side;5second compressed demonstration with a1second preview hold. The source workout hold remains20–30seconds. The two sources describe substantially the same hip stretch.
arms: Hands rest separately on the front knee and shin, with a relaxed outward elbow plane. Authored placement: the source does not specify press-hand placement.
required_renderer: Three.js approved DQ adapter with standard POSITION/NORMAL morph targets

explicit_staging.pelvis_legs: Front anatomical left thigh follows torso forward; rear right thigh lies to the side, approximately90degrees between thigh directions. Both knee bend planes follow the actual source anterior-knee frame. The previous135degree thigh spread is removed.
explicit_staging.spine: Flat-back forward hinge along the front thigh; no independent lumbar collapse. Press starts with a20degree forward orientation to keep authored separate leg-hand contacts reachable on the original arm proportions.
explicit_staging.hands: Hands rest separately on the front knee and shin, with a relaxed outward elbow plane. Authored placement: the source does not specify press-hand placement.
explicit_staging.floor: WorldZ=0m. Curved support witnesses and all-skin penetration are separate from visual silhouette acceptance.
explicit_staging.timing: 5seconds:2seconds entry,1second demonstration hold,2seconds return. Workout hold remains20–30seconds; mirrored side is instructed separately.
